description: Several panels to compare side by side the measurements of two sensor devices.

options.content:
Sensor device comparison
Several panels to compare side by side the measurements of two sensor devices. Selecting in cascade both sensors (pilot, scenario, sub_scenario and area) helps in that search.
More info about manipulating pannels in the Home screen

panels.description: Daily average values for selected pollutants for sensor_id1 in the dropdowns.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.AQ == "IAQ")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sensor_id =~ /^${sensor_id1:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field =~ /^${pollutants:regex}$/)
  |> aggregateWindow(every: 24h, fn: mean)

panels.title: Daily Mean (sensor_id [$sensor_id1])

list.name: pilot_1
list.query: Austria (AT) : AT, Germany (DE) : DE, Spain (ES) : ES, Netherlands (NL) : NL, Norway (NO) : NO, Poland (PL) : PL

list.definition:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY") 
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop) 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_") 
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot_1:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["sub_scenario"]) 
  |> distinct(column: "sub_scenario") 
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
